notes: Straight root-crack model following Peng Yue (2025): crack extension q_c starts at the tooth root and forms gamma=45 degrees with the tooth centreline. The reference case q_c=3 mm at m=5 mm has q_c/m=0.60; the middle current-gear case is module-scaled to q_c=0.90 mm at m=1.5 mm. These are simulation cases, not measured crack sizes of the present test gear.
